scenarios.name: Group search criteria for the same feature property

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part with one extrusion and no fillet is open in the MCAD Software
the Find dialog contains the criterion Type equals Extrusion
Features is the selected object type and And is selected for additional criteria
the user chooses Type equals Fillet and clicks Add to list
a prompt says criteria using the same property must be grouped
the prompt offers to add the criterion using the OR operator
the user chooses Yes
the criteria list shows Type equals Extrusion
the next line shows OR Type equals Fillet
the user closes and reopens the Find dialog
both criteria remain in the list
the user clicks Find Now
the extrusion row is selected and the block edges are highlighted
the Find dialog remains open
the user closes the Find dialog and clicks empty viewport space
the highlight disappears and the part remains visible
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part is open in the MCAD Software
the user chooses Find from the model browser menu
a search criteria dialog opens over the workspace
its object type list offers Sketches and Features
the user selects Features and opens the Property list
the list offers Name, Note contents, Note title, Suppress status and Type
the user selects Name and opens the Condition list
the list offers any value, begins with, ends with, includes, is exactly and is not
the user dismisses the list and closes the dialog
the model browser and part remain visible
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software with its model browser visible
the user chooses Find from the model browser menu
the user chooses Sketches in the object type list
the user opens the Property list
the list offers Name, Note contents, Note title and Sketch Parameter Name
the user chooses Sketch Parameter Name
the Condition field displays contains
the Value field is empty and adds to list is disabled
the user opens the Condition list
it offers contains and does not contain
the user dismisses the list and closes the dialog
the model browser and part are visible

scenarios.name: Find an extrusion by feature type

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains one extrusion forming a block
the model browser is visible
the Find criteria list is empty
the user chooses Find from the model browser menu
the user selects Features as the object type
the user selects Type as the property and Extrusion as the value
the condition displays equals
the user clicks Add to list
the criteria list contains Type equals Extrusion
the user clicks Find Now
the extrusion row is selected in the model browser
the visible edges of the block are highlighted in blue
the Find dialog remains open
the user closes the dialog
the extrusion remains selected and the block edges remain highlighted
the user clicks empty viewport space
the selection highlight disappears and the block remains visible

scenarios.name: Report no matching feature search results

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part with one unsuppressed extrusion and no fillet is open in the MCAD Software
the Find dialog contains Type equals Extrusion OR Type equals Fillet
And is selected for additional criteria
the user selects Suppress status as the property
the condition is equals and the value is Suppressed
the user clicks Add to list
the criteria list includes Suppress status equals Suppressed
the user clicks Find Now
an information message says that no objects matched the criteria
the user acknowledges the message
the Find dialog remains open with the criteria displayed
the user closes the Find dialog
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

scenarios.name: Decline grouping an additional feature type

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software with the Find dialog open
the criteria list contains Type equals Extrusion OR Type equals Fillet
the criteria list contains Suppress status equals Suppressed
And is selected for additional criteria
the user chooses Type equals Hole and clicks Add to list
a prompt offers to group the additional type criterion using OR
the user chooses No
the prompt closes and the existing three criteria remain in the list
Type equals Hole is not added to the list
the property, condition and value controls still show Type equals Hole
the user closes the Find dialog
the part remains visible
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software Find dialog contains these feature criteria in order:
the user selects the Suppress status criterion
the criterion controls show Suppress status, equals and Suppressed
And is selected
the user selects the Fillet criterion
the criterion controls show Type, equals and Fillet
Or is selected
the user selects the Extrusion criterion
the criterion controls show Type, equals and Extrusion
And is selected
the three criteria remain listed
the user closes the Find dialog
the part workspace is visible

scenarios.name: Change a pending Find value without replacing a listed criterion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software Find dialog lists Type equals Extrusion and OR Type equals Fillet
Type equals Extrusion is selected with And selected
the user chooses Hole in the Value list
the Value field shows Hole and adds to list is enabled
the listed Extrusion and Fillet criteria remain unchanged
the user selects the Fillet criterion
the controls show Type, equals, Fillet and Or
the user selects the Extrusion criterion
the controls show Type, equals, Extrusion and And
adds to list is disabled
the user closes the Find dialog
the part workspace is visible
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software Find dialog contains feature search criteria
the user chooses Save Search
a prompt shows an empty search-name field
OK is disabled and cancels is available
the user clicks Cancel
the Find dialog remains open with its criteria unchanged
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software Find dialog contains feature search criteria
at least one saved search is available
the user chooses Open Search
a picker shows a saved-search list and opens, Cancel and Delete actions
the user clicks Cancel
the Find dialog remains open with its original criteria unchanged
